tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi 'chad thabs bzhugs so// dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zin bris so// ༈ /rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid la/ gang gis 'khrid na rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas 'khrid/ gang 'khrid na mkha' spyod don du gnyer ba'i slob bu rab 'bring tha ma tha shal gyi rigs can 'khrid/ lam gang gis 'khrid na bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lam rim pa ma log pas 'khrid/ gang du 'khrid na rab mkha' spyod chen po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang du 'khrid/ 'bring tha ma mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa la sogs bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ lam gyi dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid la/ gang gis bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag des bsgrub pa'i lam dngos/ lam des 'grub pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po la smin lam la 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag lam dngos la/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma tha shal dang bcas pa'i ngos 'dzin tsam bshad rjes de thams cad kyi thun mong du nyams su blang byar gyur pa ni/ rje sa chen gyis/ nyal dang ldang dang bcas pa nas// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes 'chad par byed pa la/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ bcad don nyams su blang ba sems 'dzin gyi 'khrid la/ dang po rnam bshad la/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom pa'i sngon du ldang ba dgos la/ de'ang nyal ba 'byung ba las/ rnal 'byor dang po nyal lugs gnyis/ rnal 'byor gnyis pa ldang lugs gnyis/ gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor/ bzhi pa tshad med sems bskyed las/ de'ang sngon du skyabs 'gro 'byung bas skyabs 'gro'i rnam bshad gsungs nas/ tshad med sems bskyed kyi rnam bshad/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor las 'dir gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/

drug pa bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gyi rnal 'byor/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor bdag gzhan gyi gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur/ brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa'i rjes su lus dkyil thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam phyi ma'i nyams len kyang byas nas go cha'i lha bkod/ dgu pa ngag bzlas yid bzlas kyi rnal 'byor/ bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam dngos dang yan lag gnyis/ dang po la snang grags rig gsum gyi nyams len/ phyi ma la/ dang po la kha zas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gnyis pa la phyi rol mchod pa/ gsum pa tshogs 'khor/ bzhi pa sbyin sreg bya ba thab la brten pa/ ma brten pa/ mar ma'i sbyin sreg gnyis rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i yi ge bzhin/ lnga pa tshes bcu'i dam bca' rgyas bsdus/ drug pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis gang zag rab kyi nyams len bya tshul/ gang zag 'bring gis laṅka li'i shing la brten pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum bya tshul/ gang zag tha mas 'pho ba'i nyams len/ yab yum zhal sbyor dang yum rkyang 'pho ba gang rung bya tshul gyi nyams len bstan nas de dag gis bya tshul/ shin tu tha mas smon lam spyi dang bye brag nyams su blangs pas mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang thob pa sogs kyis bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i rnam bshad skabs su gang babs shes par bya'o// spyi'i gnyis pa bcad don nyams su blang ba la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ thun mong la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams yin kyang 'khrid 'og song*/ gnyis pa la lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro/ lam dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyang ba yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor/

byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dang po la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ gang gi skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag dus nam kyi tshe/ dgos pa gang gis/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'o// sems bskyed la kun rdzob dang*/ don dam las/ dang po la smon 'jug gsum pa la lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba gshegs gsol bya ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ zhal shes dang po nyams su blangs nas/ gnyis pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes yan byas pa'i bsod nams tshogs gsog dang*/ bla ma dang rang sems 'dres pa'i stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas ye shes tshogs gsog gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang*/ byed pa can gyi bskyed rim gyi bya ba ni/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e e zhes pa nas phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i bar gyi ngag 'don/ de nas ngag bzlas sogs kyi rjes la/ yid bzlas/ zhar byung rdzogs rim yan grub rjes/ gnyis pa byed pa can gyi bskyed rim la/ nga rgyal la sems bzung ba dang*/ rnam pa la sems bzung ba/ gnyis pa la/ spyi la sems bzung ba/ bye brag la sems bzung ba/ bye brag la yang*/ rgyan can dang rgyan med gnyis/ de rjes bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin rnams kyis rten bskyed pa'i rim pa/ spyi'i gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul/ lam bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad do// gnyis pa la chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/ chos nyid rgyud nas ston pa'o// phyi ma la dpe gsum gyis don gcig gtan la phab ste/ 'di la chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba/ chags bral rnal 'byor pa'i lam la dga' ba'o// phyi ma la dbu mar rlung sems rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ phyi ma la rlung lus la gnas pa bde ba sgrub pa dang*/

rlung sems la zhugs pa 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang mdzad tshul lo// thun bsdu tshul thun mong ba rnams la bsam mi khyab thun mong bas bsdu zhing snod ldan la zhal shes gsum pa chig brgyud du sbyin nas des thun bsdu ba'o// khrid kyi 'gor yig brgya/ gsol 'debs/ mchod gtor/ maṇ+ḍal/ rgyab chos lung la sogs pa nges par mdzad do// rgyal ba kun dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi// rgyal tshab thugs sras dam pa sding ma ba'i// gsung rgyun zhal drod ma nyams gsang ba'i gtam// skal ldan snying gi bu la bsams nas gtad// ces snod ldan gyi slob bu 'a zhwa'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa rnam dpyod kyi blo gros mkha' ltar yangs pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ngor 'a zhwa'i ban+de theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dbang gi ming gis legs par bgyis pas slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ ༈ /

lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /lam 'khrul med gdams pa'i snying khu 'di// 'gran zla med mkhyen gsal rgya mtsho yi// gsung bslu med gser chos man ngag 'di// thugs dad ldan dran pa gsal 'debs yin// 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor mas jo bo nā ro ta pa la dngos su gdams pa'i gser chos mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nyams len 'phyugs med thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi gnad/ drin chen bla ma blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi pad+mo las kho bo cag gi thos 'dzin bung ba gzhon nu bcud du myang ba'i snyan brgyud ni/ nā ro mkha' spyod rnal 'byor bcu gcig bzlas pa gnyis tshar ba'i bsam mi khyab thun mo ma yin pa'i tshab tu'am/ yang na zur du nyams su len na rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal btab pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chu shing ltar drang ba mda' snyug 'bring po tsam/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab la/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba ste khyad chos bzhi yin/ yar rtse tshangs bug dang mar rtse lte bar zug pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gro sogs 'bring po tsam/ de gnyis yar rtse tshangs bug nas sba gug pa ltar mdun du 'khyog sna bug g.yas g.yon du ha re zug pa/ mas sna lte bar zug pa/ rtsa gsum 'dzom pa'i mas snar/ lte ba'i bam̐ dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig sku mdog rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal btab/ de la rang sems zhugs pa bzhin dbyer med du bsres pas/ de las chu las chu bur rdor ba ltar ram/ rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig me stag yar ba ltar/ rlung phyir 'gro 'ong dang bstun g.yas ro ma nas 'khyug ste song*/ sna bug g.yas pa'i bu ga nas thon smin mtshams kyi thad du 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang du gsal le bzhugs te/

de la yid gtad pas de las sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du thams cad las chos nyan mchod pas mnyes par byas/ ma dag pa snod bcud thams cad dag par byas/ sems can thams cad la chos bshad/ sdig sgrib byang bar byas/ slar 'dus smin mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de nyid nang du 'jug pa dang bstun sna bug g.yon rkyang ma nas byung*/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la bstim zhing rlung kha sbyar ci thub bzung*/ de lta bu spro bsdu dang rlung gi sbyor ba ci rigs la lam sbyang ba'i mthar/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i bam̐ las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad dmar khrig khrig gang*/ yan lag thams cad 'od du zhu lus spyi la thim/ ḍā ma ru sogs kyi sgra sgrogs pas rkyen byas te/ lte ba'i rang sems kyi rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du chas te snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo'i thad 'od phung gi bar du rim gyis bskyod pas/ ro rkyang zhabs la 'jus te/ rtsa gsum thung ril li li song*/ de tshangs bug gi thad kyi 'od phung gi steng du rnal 'byor ma yer gyis 'thon/ de tsam na rtsa gsum 'od phung dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rnal 'byor ma de nyid la thim/ rang sems kyi rnal 'byor ma de mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin/ sgra 'od rol mo dang bcas pas bsus te/ blos mi khyud pas dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du khams gsum yud kyi byon pas de la rang sems ci gnas bzung*/ slar gzugs sku'i rnal 'byor ma de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos sku'i rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim nas/ gsal stong zung 'jug dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings la sems 'bol shig ge yun ring du mnyam par bzhag slar yang 'od gsal de'i ngang las nam mkha' la sprin langs pa bzhin/ rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid langs te/ thur du bya babs pa bzhin rang gnas sngar bzhin gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal btab te yid spro seng nge ba la mnyam par bzhag

de lta bu'i dmigs pa nyer gcig nas bdun gyi bar ram/ yang na nyams len chig dril gyis thun grangs blos ci lcogs bya ste/ 'di la nyams len mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang mang po 'ja' lus la mkha' spyod du song ba'i yid ches pa'i gtam rgyud mang po yod gsung ngo*// smras pa/ 'ja' lus 'od kyi mkha' la dgyes dgur spyod// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi dpal la rol// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang skal ba mnyam// mkha' spyod dam pa'i snying por longs par shog /rtsa gsum 'dus mdor bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// gcig la gnyis spros 'bar ba'i lam nas song*// yangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' 'od gur khang mdzes// rang sems 'od gsal zin par byin gyis rlobs// sprul pa yang sprul rgyal ba'i zhing khams spros// gdams pa'i bcud myangs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// 'gro la chos bstan ma dag zhing khams sbyangs// sprul skur mdzad phreng smin par byin gyis rlobs// slar 'dus sprul pa yang sprul gcig la bsdus// dkar ba'i lam nas nang gi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig gdod ma srog gi a la thim// phyi nang rnal 'byor mjal bar byin gyis rlobs// mkha' spyod zhing nas dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas// bdug spos sprin dang me tog chun po'i char// cang te'u snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bos tshe// rab dkar bag chags sad par byin gyis rlobs// bam̐ yig zer gyis gzhi lus 'od du zhu// nang gi mkha' spyod gtsug tu 'phags pa'i mod// rtsa gsum 'od phung rnal 'byor ma der thim// mkha' spyod yud kyis bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// 'dab ldan dbang po mkha' la bya 'phur bzhin// mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma tshogs rol mo'i sgras// nam mkha'i gzhal med khang brtsegs bye ba'i dbus// mkha' spyod dpal la rol bar= /rang sems rgyal ba'i thugs dang 'dres pa'i mod// gzugs sku'i 'ja' ris nam mkha'i 'dzum gyis bsus// gsal stong zung 'jug gsang ba'i rnal 'byor mas// chos sku'i zhing khams mjal bar=

/slar yang las smon dri bzhon dal bu yis// gzugs sku'i 'ja' dkar bag chags gnas su zug /phyi rol rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dga' bde'i dpal la rol= /rang lus ma spangs rang sems dwangs ma'i shel// lang tsho dar la dbang po'i gzhu ris can// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'du ba'i grong khyer du// ci bsam lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// e ma 'dren mchog tshar chen chos kyi rje// mkha' spyod zhing nas pho nya rnam gsum gyis// bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i 'gro ba kun// khyod bzhugs gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs so// 'di la sa skya'i kha cig gis/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zhes kyang bya/ phyogs gcig nang gi rnal 'byor ma zhes kyang bzhed de/ rang lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i nyams len bsam mi khyab/ gang ltar yang 'gal ba med mod/ gzhan dag la ming tsam grags kyang don gyi snying po 'di med par gces par zungs shig 'di lta bu'i yi ge sngon chad med kyang*/ dad brtson snying stobs dang ldan pa'i 'dar nas mi dbang dpyod ldan chos kyi lhun grub kyis gser gyi me tog chun po dang yang yang dran gsos btab pa nas/ de nyid kyi thugs dam nyams bzhes su/ mkha' spyod dbang mo'i rnal 'byor pa nā gardzu nas 'dar chos 'khor yang rtse'i gtsang khang du cung zad gsal bar bris pa la bla ma mkha' 'gros dges pa'i phyag gis rnam pa kun tu bzung du gsol// ༈ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gi sgo nas sngags khrus nad thams cad la phan pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sngags khrus phyag len 'di ltar te/ sbyor ba byams snying rjes kun nas bslang ngo*// de nas ras sam snam bu dkar po'i steng du nas bkram/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bri/ chu gtsang bre do la lo tsha dmar po'i grogs btab la gdan gyi steng du bzhag go /mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bsham sta gon no// de nas rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gcig bsgoms la/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa byas la stong rtsa gcig bzlas la/ brgya rtsa re song ba dang thun blug go /de nas gtor ma re gtong ngo*// bsnyen pa'o// de nas ltong bkug la bzlas pa byas pa'i sngags chu de btab pas/ rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa'i nad thams cad khrus kyi sgo nas sbyang bar 'gyur ro// nad la sogs pa 'thon 'thon du sngags chus sbyangs te 'thungs pa khrus ci 'dod 'byung ngo*// nad thon pa'i rtags su chu sngo rgyang ste 'byung ngo*// las sbyar ro// zan dron dang tshod dron gyis khrus gcod do// rjes smon dang cha mthun no// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags khrus 'di la yid ches pa yod pas gces spras bya'o// khyad par gyi sngags 'di dgos lags so// oṃ bha ra hi/ kha ṭ+wa ga bha ra hi/ tsa mun+d+ri bha ra hi/ ka ka bha ra hi/ khyad par gyi sngags 'di tsho smra ba bcad la mis mi tshor ba bzla ba gal che zhes zhal shes yin no// bla ma dam pa tshar pa chos rje'i gsung las byung ba zin bris su byas pa'o// ༈ / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+re wā ra h+yai/ rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// nā ro pham thing klog skya mal lo'i zhabs// gong ma lnga dang zhang ston brag phug pa// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs// bla ma dam pa yar klung khu dbon gnyis// 'jam dbyangs chos rje yab sras kun spangs zhabs// tshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum dpal// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs// dbang phyug rab brtan rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// chos dbyings rang grol mkhan chen zhwa lu rjes// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs// dbang bzhi bskur bas rgyud smin sin+dhu ra'i// dkyil 'khor la brten bdag byin rab rlabs nas// bskyed rdzogs slob bshad zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur shog

/ces nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs shin tu 'khyer bde ba zhig bris shig ces zhwa lu'i gdan sa nyer gcig pa rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi ban+dhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma mchog dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bzlas pa gnyis grub rjes chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma phyi bltas na nang gsal/ nang bltas na phyi gsal/ kha dog dmar po nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par bsam pa'i lus kyi dbus na yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan rta rnga ltar phra ba/ rgya skyegs ltar dmar ba/ chu shing ltar drang ba/ til me ltar gsal ba/ yar sna smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas spyi gtsug la byas pa/ mas sna lte ba'i 'khor lo la byas pa mtheb sor tsam ma reg pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo gro sog tsam/ yar sna sna bug g.yas nas spyi bo la byas/ mar sna dbu ma las mtheb sor gyis ring ba/ g.yon rkyang ma yang des 'gres/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bam̐ yig de rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs thugs kar chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs dkyus bzhin la/ zhabs gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba'i spyi bo dbu ma la zug pa/ ro rkyang gnyis sku'i g.yas g.yon zhabs kyi mthil du zug par bsam/ de nas rang sems dang rje btsun ma dbyer med pa'i ngo bo bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de la rje btsun ma'i sku che chung me stag lta bu'i rnam pa can/ sku lus g.yas phyogs nas zhabs g.yas pa'i nang nas mar song*/

ro ma'i sne mo zhabs mthil du zug pa la zhugs/ ro ma'i nang nas yar bya gnam 'phang bskyod pa bzhin gyen du song*/ sna bug g.yas nas bung ba tshang nas thon pa bzhin song*/ de las de 'dra ba'i sku che chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa rnams la dges pa'i mchod pa/ sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sogs mdor na snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i rang bzhin du byas/ de rnams tshur 'dus sna sgo'i rnal 'byor ma de la thim de nyid sna bug g.yon nas rkyang ma'i nang brgyud/ rim gyis song ba zhabs mthil g.yon nas yar byas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de lta bu rlung 'gro 'ong dang bstun pa'am mi bstun kyang lan ci mang bya'o// ma mtha' yang gsum tsam byed/ de nas bam̐ la sems cher gtad pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku'i smad phyogs la phog pas/ 'od kyi rnam pas sku'i phyogs las yar 'dus de bzhin du stod la song bas mas yar 'dus/ 'od dmar po rdza ma tsam du gyur/ de yang rje btsun ma la thim/ de nas rje btsun ma de nyid snying ga'i thad du spar gyis byon pas ro rkyang gnyis 'dus te/ zhabs cung zad na re yod pa/ de nas mgrin pa'i thad du spar gyis byon/ ro rkyang lhag ma ma lus par 'dus/ de man chad kyi dbu ma'ang sku ji ltar yar byon pa ltar 'dus/ de nas spyi bo'i thad du yar byon pas/ phyi'i rnal 'byor ma nang gi rnal 'byor mar thim par gsungs so/ dbu ma'ang 'dus te/ rje btsun ma'i sku gcig po dang rang sems dbyer med par spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs shing*/ der 'gro ba'i bzhed pa drag po dang bcas pas spyan gzigs lugs dang*/ thugs kyi bzhed pa'i dmigs pa 'di snying ga dang mgrin pa lte ba gsum la'ang dgos rgyu yin/ de dang de'i skabs de dang de la sems gtad nas cung zad re 'jog go

/de nas rje btsun ma mkha' spyod du gshegs te/ je mtho nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyi spros med la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag de la mi gnas na/ mkha' spyod nas rje btsun ma slar rang nyid 'dug pa'i thad tsam du byon/ de'i rkyen gyis ro rkyang dbu ma rje btsun ma yang yang gsal btab/ sngar bzhin dmigs pa bya/ de 'dra ba len ci mang bya'o// 'di la mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nang gi rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba zhes bzhed do// zhes pa 'di'ang ring mo bas brjed thor bris pa'o// ༈ / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gsung khrid kyi dmigs rim ni// ༈ /mkha' spyod gtso mo'i zab 'khrid nyams len rnams// go rim khrigs su sdebs na 'di yin te// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang*// nyams len slob bshad zab mo'i yi ge bzhin// grub rjes bdag nyid lhar bskyed 'gro ba dag /ye shes spyan drangs bstim nas lus dkyil gsal// go cha bgo zhing sngags dmigs gsal btab nas// ngag bzlas grub rjes rlung bzung yid bzlas byas// de rjes zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis bsgoms nas// phyi dang lus dkyil rnams la sems 'dzin byed// de nas rje btsun yab yum la brten nas// 'pho ba'i dmigs pa grub rjes bum can bzung*// dbu ma kha bye'i dmigs pa grub mtshams su// yongs la ma grub rlung lnga'i ti la ka /zhes pa'i don gyi dmigs pa thun mong dang*// thun mong ma yin rnam pa gnyis bsgom dus// bum can bzung zhing grub rjes 'khrid yig na// bzhugs pa'i lus la gnas pa'i rlung dmigs bya// 'di ni bum can bzung ngam mi bzung ba// gdam kar gsung ba bzung ba legs zhes gsungs// de rjes dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nyid nas// sems la rlung bsdu stong pa bsgrub pa yin// nyams len byed cing steng 'og rlung sbyar bas// grub na legs shing ma bzung chad skyon med// de dag rdzogs nas thun mong ma yin pa'i// bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthar// dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam bkra shis bya// 'di dag rje btsun bla ma'i gsung ji bzhin// nor 'khrul med par bkod pa'i brjed tho lags//
